fit_kernel_density: fit a KernelDensity model with bandwidth and kernel parameters on training data
score_samples_kernel_density: score samples using a fitted KernelDensity model to estimate log density values
sample_from_kernel_density: generate random samples from a fitted KernelDensity model
test_kernel_density_kernels: test KernelDensity with gaussian, tophat, epanechnikov, exponential, linear, and cosine kernels
test_kernel_density_bandwidth: test KernelDensity with automatic bandwidth strategies scott and silverman
test_kernel_density_sample_weights: test KernelDensity with sample weights for weighted density estimation
test_kernel_density_pipeline_gridsearch: test KernelDensity integration with sklearn pipeline and GridSearchCV for hyperparameter tuning
test_kernel_density_pickling: test pickling a fitted KernelDensity model with joblib and verify predictions match
test_kernel_density_not_fitted: test that an unfitted KernelDensity model raises NotFittedError on score_samples and sample calls
